content:
The HWPX document generation failed because modified paragraphs incorrectly retained layout cache elements, violating document integrity rules.
The test 'test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache' failed with an AssertionError when checking section0.xml and section1.xml. Specifically, modified paragraphs containing training feedback data still contained 'hp:linesegarray' elements (AssertionError: assert <Element...linesegarray> is None). This indicates that while text injection worked, the implementation failed to strip the stale layout cache from the HWPML XML structure as required for modified content.
